$:set -euo pipefail
p=user/codespaces/shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96
state() { gh api "$p" --jq .state; }
s=$(state)
printf 'Initial: %s\n' "$s"
if [[ "$s" == Starting ]]; then
  for i in {1..20}; do s=$(state); [[ "$s" != Starting ]] && break; sleep 3; done
fi
if [[ "$s" != Shutdown && "$s" != ShuttingDown ]]; then gh api --method POST "$p/stop" >/dev/null; fi
for i in {1..25}; do s=$(state); [[ "$s" == Shutdown ]] && break; sleep 3; done
[[ "$s" == Shutdown ]]
echo 'Stopped: Shutdown'
gh api --method POST "$p/start" >/dev/null
for i in {1..35}; do s=$(state); if [[ "$s" == Available ]]; then echo 'Restarted: Available'; exit 0; fi; sleep 3; done
printf 'Start timed out: %s\n' "$s"
exit 1
